description:
I've avoided making this for ages now as I just don’t like perfume flavoured things like this and Parma violets but so many have asked for it, so here we are! 

The standard Salt & Straw base is used here which uses Xanthan gum only as it’s stabilizer. I’ve remained true to the recipe here so you can see what it actually turns out like.  Tyler Malek makes this himself on some videos but he stops the churn a little early for my liking and ends up pouring the churned ice cream in to the tub. I recommend you churn a little longer until you can scoop it from the machine. 

So what does it taste like? It tastes like spring and summer with the smell of lavender creating more emotion than the flavour itself (which I don't like btw 😆 ), or you can watch the video and see what I actually say about it 😉

This is a pretty divisive flavour and if you only sold this and marmite/vegimite ice cream some people would just punch you in the face 😂

Depending on where you are, the dried flowers are pretty expensive so only if you like floral flavours, give it a try. 

Ingredients

The Lavender Part:
86g (¼ cup) wildflower honey
20g (½ cup) dried food grade lavender buds
180g ir ml (3/4 cup) water
750ml (3 cups) Ice Cream Base (see below), very cold
10 drops natural purple food coloring

The Ice Cream Part:
100g (½ cup) Granulated sugar
30g (2 tbsp) Skimmed milk powder
1.4g (¼ tsp) Xanthan gum (available on amazon, ebay, or basically anywhere on the internet!)
30g (2 tbsp) Corn syrup (NOT high fructose corn syrup)
315ml (1⅓ cups) Whole milk @2.4% (or there abouts)
315ml (1⅓ cups) Heavy cream @37% (or there abouts)

I would recommend using the purple food colouring as it creates a story and emotion for the ice cream, the brain tells you what it'll be like by looking at it.
